_comment: The same helmet listed twice because two labs named it differently. Each duplicate id is folded into the kept id: lab results and aero data the kept helmet lacks move over, the duplicate is dropped. Applied by enrich.merges.apply_helmet_merges. Only add a pair after checking it is the same product (not a MIPS/non-MIPS or older version); two tests by the same lab are two versions and stay separate.
